content: {"episode_id":"ep-05110","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered because the patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, coded as R55, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia.
